topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The world stretches out in wait, as time loops and the airport hums with its own quiet rhythm. I trace the pattern of the tiles with my eyes, each one a square of earth and sky, holding untold stories. The announcement of the delay drifts by, a whisper on the breeze, and I let it move through me without resistance. Plans shift, adapt, and remake themselves, like clouds reshaping against the wind. The missed event, a forgotten letter, slips gently from my hands. There will be other moments, other meetings, under different stars. For now, I linger here, in this in-between place, where the soul finds its own gentle pace.
